crossRefs.note: For the king had a fleet of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came…
King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of…

parallels.note: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go; for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

people.name: Ezion-geber
people.line: Israelite encampment; port city on Red Sea

people.name: Tarshish
people.line: Distant maritime city known for its wealth and trade

translations.web: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. They made the ships in Ezion Geber.
translations.bsb: They agreed to make ships to go to Tarshish, and these were built in Ezion-geber.
translations.kjv: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongeber.
translations.asv: and he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish; and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.
